execution_plans.description: Collect sources, validate evidence, synthesize findings, and produce a research brief.

escalation_conditions: source discovery requires broader web access
large context analysis exceeds local confidence
the task requires stronger research synthesis

success_criteria: Relevant sources are collected and validated.
Key findings are synthesized into a concise brief.
The result can be traced back to cited evidence.
execution_plans.notes: Research is local-first by default and escalates only when broader source discovery or stronger synthesis is justified.

execution_plans.description: Locate, filter, and organize source candidates for later analysis or reporting.

escalation_conditions: broader discovery is needed
the candidate set is sparse
the search space benefits from cloud retrieval support

success_criteria: Source candidates are collected from relevant channels.
Each candidate has enough metadata to evaluate usefulness.
The output is ready for later research or reporting.
execution_plans.notes: This plan stops at discovery and does not perform full synthesis.

execution_plans.description: Ingest large inputs, segment them, compare themes, and produce structured findings.

escalation_conditions: context length exceeds local capacity
cross-document synthesis requires a stronger reasoning model
confidence metadata indicates a better provider

success_criteria: Large inputs are organized into manageable segments.
Cross-source patterns are identified and summarized.
The result is concise enough for operator review.
execution_plans.notes: This plan emphasizes synthesis and comparison rather than source gathering.

execution_plans.description: Draft a structured report or briefing from prepared inputs.

escalation_conditions: the draft needs stronger prose quality
the report requires polished structure
the source material is large or complex

success_criteria: The report follows a clear structure.
The text is readable and operator-friendly.
The output matches the requested format.
execution_plans.notes: Prefer strong writing quality, but keep the plan deterministic and explainable.

execution_plans.description: Inspect a draft for clarity, correctness, and actionable findings.

escalation_conditions: the review requires stronger critique
the draft is lengthy or subtle
the operator requested a cloud review model

success_criteria: Findings are specific and actionable.
The review distinguishes high-priority issues from minor ones.
The review does not modify the source draft.
execution_plans.notes: Review is inspection only and stays separate from execution.

execution_plans.description: Plan repository or code changes, tests, and implementation notes.

escalation_conditions: the implementation benefits from a code-oriented cloud model
the repository scope is large
the task requires stronger patch synthesis

success_criteria: The intended code change is described precisely.
The plan names the expected test or validation steps.
The work remains approval-gated before any modification.
execution_plans.notes: Planning may describe repository changes, but no modification occurs here.

execution_plans.description: Inspect code changes and surface review findings before any merge or release.

escalation_conditions: the diff is large
the review needs a stronger critique model
the operator explicitly selects a cloud reviewer

success_criteria: Potential issues are listed and prioritized.
The review explains the impact of each finding.
The result stays separate from implementation.
execution_plans.notes: Use this plan for inspection, not implementation.

execution_plans.description: Plan repository changes and the checks required before committing them.

escalation_conditions: repository edits are large or cross-cutting
the change benefits from a code-oriented cloud model
additional patch synthesis is required

success_criteria: The repository impact is described in a bounded sequence.
The validation work is named before execution.
Approval remains required before any file change.
execution_plans.notes: Repository modification remains governed and cannot execute inside this layer.

execution_plans.description: Design deterministic automation logic and orchestration flow before implementation.

escalation_conditions: workflow design needs code-oriented synthesis
the control flow is large or branching
the operator wants a stronger automation model

success_criteria: The workflow logic is deterministic and bounded.
Inputs, states, and outputs are identified.
The design does not execute or dispatch anything.
execution_plans.notes: Automation design is a specification step, not an execution step.

execution_plans.description: Prepare an n8n workflow design for later governed implementation.

escalation_conditions: the n8n graph is large
node selection benefits from code-oriented synthesis
the workflow requires a stronger provider

success_criteria: The n8n workflow is described in a deterministic graph form.
Control flow and data flow are explicit.
No workflow is generated or executed here.
execution_plans.notes: The planning layer may describe n8n, but it does not call n8n.

execution_plans.description: Analyze restricted material locally without cloud exposure.

escalation_conditions: cloud escalation is prohibited
restricted material must remain local
category 2 work cannot leave the machine

success_criteria: All inputs remain local-only.
No cloud provider is suggested or required.
The result makes the restriction boundary explicit.
execution_plans.notes: Category 2 work is local-only and cannot be routed to a cloud provider.

execution_plans.description: Inspect or transform local files while keeping the route local-only.

escalation_conditions: cloud escalation is prohibited
file work stays local
the task must not expose local data

success_criteria: The files are processed without leaving the local boundary.
The output is structured for operator review.
No cloud path appears in the plan.
execution_plans.notes: Category 2 file operations stay local even when the content is simple.

execution_plans.description: Summarize local system state into a dashboard-ready status report.

escalation_conditions: dashboard status must stay local
cloud escalation is prohibited
the status snapshot is derived from local state

success_criteria: Status is derived from local state only.
The summary is concise and dashboard-ready.
No cloud escalation is possible.
execution_plans.notes: Dashboard reporting remains within the restricted local boundary.

execution_plans.description: Distill bounded memory candidates into a usable local memory packet.

escalation_conditions: memory packets stay local
cloud escalation is prohibited
the summary must not expose restricted data

success_criteria: The memory packet is short, bounded, and local-only.
Reusable lessons are captured without overfitting.
No cloud provider appears in the route.
execution_plans.notes: Memory summarization is intended for controlled, local knowledge capture.

execution_plans.description: Review a successful workflow as a candidate for future skill promotion.

escalation_conditions: skill promotion review stays local
cloud escalation is prohibited
the review should remain bounded and auditable

success_criteria: The candidate workflow is evaluated locally.
The review explains why promotion is or is not warranted.
The output remains advisory rather than executable.
execution_plans.notes: Skill promotion review remains local-only so the evaluation surface stays bounded.
